run_prepare_mexpresso: run the prepare_mexpresso script to create mExpresso Eng-XXX S2T dataset manifests
build_en_manifest_from_oss: build an English manifest from Open Source Expresso dataset with audio downsampling to 16kHz
convert_to_16khz_wav: convert 48kHz stereo audio files to mono 16kHz WAV format using torchaudio
multiprocess_map: multiprocess map a function over a list with configurable worker count and chunksize
test_main_cli: test the main CLI entry point with output folder and optional existing expresso root arguments
